title: Compatibility of tangent coefficients with addition and scaling
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $x\in X$, $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $K=\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field], and $s:k\to R$ the structural map. Suppose $r=\operatorname{res}\circ s:k\to K$ is bijective. Let $T=T_{X/k,x}$ be the dual-number tangent space with its prescribed vector operations [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space]. Restrict scalars of $T$ and $\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2$ along $r$, where $\mathfrak m$ is the maximal ideal of $R$. For a tangent vector $\theta$ whose closed point is $x$, write $\theta^\sharp:R\to K[\epsilon]$ for its transported closed-point stalk homomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-local-ring]. For any function $C:T\to\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m/\mathfrak m^2,k)$ such that each $\theta$ maps the closed point to $x$ and $r(C(\theta)([a]))$ is the epsilon coefficient of $\theta^\sharp(a)$ for every $a\in\mathfrak m$, we have $C(\theta+\eta)=C(\theta)+C(\eta)$ for all $\theta,\eta\in T$ and $C(c\theta)=cC(\theta)$ for all $c\in k$, $\theta\in T$. This assumes a coefficient assignment and asserts only its operation laws.

proof.text: Given two tangent vectors, glue them to the square-zero spectrum with two coordinates using the pushout in `exists_tangentVectors_vectorSpace`. The selected additive structure takes the sum by precomposition with the map sending both coordinates to epsilon.

Morphisms from a local spectrum are recovered from their stalk homomorphisms. Hence precomposition with a spectrum map composes the corresponding local ring homomorphisms. The two projections extract the two second coordinates of the glued stalk map, and their sum extracts the sum of these coordinates. Thus the coefficient functional of the sum is the sum of the coefficient functionals, on every maximal-ideal representative.

The selected scalar operation is precomposition with epsilon scaling. Applying the same composition identity shows that this multiplies each second coordinate by the scalar. A `k`-scalar acts through `r` on both tangent and cotangent spaces.
Injectivity of `r` gives the functional equalities over `k`. The cotangent quotient is generated by its maximal-ideal representatives, so these equalities hold everywhere.

theorem rationalTangent_coefficient_operation_compatibility
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) :
    let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let K := X.residueField x
    let r : k →+* K :=
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (p x) ≫ p.stalkMap x ≫ X.residue x).hom
    Function.Bijective r →
    letI : Module k (schemeTangentSpace k X p x) :=
      Module.compHom (schemeTangentSpace k X p x) r
    letI : Module K (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R))
    letI : Module k (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) :=
      Module.compHom (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R) r
    ∀ C : schemeTangentSpace k X p x → (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace R →ₗ[k] k),
      (∀ θ : schemeTangentSpace k X p x,
        ∃ hx : θ.val (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (DualNumber K)) = x,
          ∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R,
            r (C θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).toCotangent a)) =
              ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun y : X ↦ X.presheaf.stalk y) hx.symm) ≫
                Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo θ.val).hom a).snd) →
      (∀ θ η, C (θ + η) = C θ + C η) ∧
        (∀ (a : k) θ, C (a • θ) = a • C θ)
